decisions.note: Keep as modular chassis; no model family is architecture-mandated.
Interfaces now; cross-domain trunk training after data/execution/audit are stable.
Use ratio_grid for labels; prefer differentiable monotone competing-risk surface over cummin post-processing.
Named ratios retained as markers/placebos, not privileged constants.
Must include actual-trial identity, lineage, hashes and per-period return references; summary metrics alone are insufficient for PBO.
Only with aligned return matrices; purge/embargo overlapping labels.
Direct-source preferred; release timestamps must be authoritative or conservatively tagged, not generic hard-coded lags.
Accrue from actual historical funding event timestamps/intervals.
Versioned venue/date/notional schedules plus sensitivity models.
Add deterministic conditioning fallback and caps.
Use structured ExpertForecast so Matrix Kelly receives calibrated expected-return units/horizons.
Retain deterministic baseline; compare candidates out of sample.
Manifest/hash/allowlist; no arbitrary auto-import in authority-bearing process.
After Stage 0-3; all search trials count in ledger; final holdout protected.
Phase 2/3 future work; no live authority.
Not required for current code architecture and should not steer the quant implementation.
